prompt:
Use the approved artisan master as the exact identity, proportion, palette and outline reference. Preserve the saffron turban, indigo turban tail, ochre angrakha, maroon sash, gold jewellery, warm skin, bold black ink outlines, flat earthy fills and decorative geometric fabric motifs. Original Rajasthani folk-art cutout design. No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime anatomy, no soft AI gradient, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows, no ground plane, no complete character.

Create one 3x2 rig-parts sheet. Each cell contains exactly one isolated body part, centered and fully inside its cell. Do not overlap cells. Do not draw connecting limbs or a full body. Keep the same profile orientation, outline weight and scale relationship as the master.

Row 1: ochre angrakha torso with shoulder caps and armholes, no head, no arms; maroon waist sash; gold necklace.
Row 2: indigo shoulder sash; pelvis/hip garment base with dhoti waistband, no legs; leave the final cell empty green/transparent.

Use a fully transparent background. Every part must have clean native alpha and be separated from every other part by transparent gutters.
